## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长百分比及计算过程

**计算结果：同比增长 32%（按报告口径）/ 31%（按恒定汇率口径）**

| 项目 | Q4 FY26（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日） | Q4 FY25（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日） | 变动 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | **$39,306M** | **$29,878M** | +$9,428M |

**计算过程：**
$$\text{同比增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100\% = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100\% \approx 31.55\%$$

微软管理层在披露中四舍五入表述为 **32%**（恒定汇率口径为 31%，汇率对收入的影响为 $80M）。

> **出处：** `financial_statements.txt` 中利润表（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 vs 2025），以及 `press_release.txt` 第 3115 行原文："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"。

---

### 2. 管理层在财报电话会上给出的增长归因

以下为 transcript 中对 Intelligent Cloud 分部的逐层归因原文引用：

**（a）Azure 及其他云服务（收入增长 43%）**

> *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"*

**（b）本地服务器业务（收入同比基本持平，恒定汇率下 -1%）**

> *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"*

**（c）分部层面的毛利率说明**

> *"Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."*

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述的逐条区分

#### ✅ 已发生的事实（对 Q4 FY26 实际业绩的回顾性描述）

| # | 归因要素 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **客户需求持续超过可用产能** | 原文："Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity." —— 描述当前状态 |
| 2 | **CPU/GPU 集群的效率提升** | 原文："Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" —— 解释 Q4 已实现的增长 |
| 3 | **流程改进使新产能更早交付** | 原文："process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" —— Q4 实际发生的运营改进 |
| 4 | **季度内新增 Azure 产能被快速变现** | 原文："That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" —— 已完成的动作 |
| 5 | **GitHub Copilot 消费超预期（6 月商业模式调整后）** | 原文："Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" —— 已观察到的结果 |
| 6 | **本地服务器续约合同结构带来更高当期收入确认** | 原文："renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" —— Q4 实际发生的续约结果 |

**区分依据：** 以上所有表述均以过去时态或状态描述（"grew"、"was"、"benefited"、"continues to exceed"），是对 **已完成的 FY26 Q4 业绩** 的归因。

#### 🔮 前瞻性表述（对未来的展望）

| # | 前瞻性表述 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **FY27 Q1 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引：$409.5 亿–$412.5 亿美元，同比增长 33%–34%** | transcript 第 32535 行："For Intelligent Cloud, we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%." |
| 2 | **Azure 恒定汇率增长约 45%** | 同上："In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" |
| 3 | **上半年（H1 FY27）Azure 增速将继续加速** | 同上："Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate." |
| 4 | **本地服务器收入将下降低至中个位数** | 同上："In our on-premises server business, we expect revenue to decline in the low to mid-single digits" |
| 5 | **管理层将持续关注效率提升以弥合供需缺口** | 同上："we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply." |

**区分依据：** 以上表述均使用将来时态的预期性措辞（"we expect"、"will"、"continue to expect"），并附有明确的数字区间或增长率指引，属于管理层对 **未来季度业绩的前瞻性预测**，受产能交付时间、合同组合、市场动态等不确定因素影响。

---

**总结：** FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入 $393 亿（+32%），增长驱动力主要来自 Azure（+43%）的产能效率提升与 GitHub Copilot 消费超预期。管理层对 Q4 的归因均为已发生的事实，而对 FY27 Q1 及 H1 的指引则属于前瞻性表述。
